title: HTTP/3 RFC 9114 Dynamic QPACK Stream-State Verification
verification_method: Focused HTTP/3 loopback tests, affected Release build, SpecTrace core validation, generated QUIC triage, and diff hygiene.
scope: This verification covers local HTTP/3 client and server integration with QPACK encoder-stream state for dynamic field-section decoding. It does not verify external h3spec completion, live interop peers, or ProtocolLab publication.
preconditions: The client advertises explicit QPACK dynamic table capacity and blocked-stream credit for the positive dynamic response test.
The negative response test advertises zero blocked-stream credit while the peer sends a dynamic response field section before encoder instructions.
procedure: Regenerate `specs/generated/quic/quic-requirement-coverage-triage.json` and confirm all QUIC requirements remain trace clean.
expected_result: The positive dynamic response test must keep the response incomplete until peer QPACK encoder-stream instructions arrive, then complete with the dynamic `server: incursa-dynamic` header and body. The negative response test must throw a QPACK decompression error when blocked-stream credit is zero. The existing dynamic request test must continue to pass through the server peer encoder-stream path. SpecTrace validation, generated triage, and diff hygiene must remain clean.
status_summary: On 2026-06-16, the affected test project built in Release and the focused HTTP/3 dynamic QPACK tests passed locally: client dynamic response unblock, client blocked-stream-credit rejection, and existing server dynamic request decode. This is repo-local protocol evidence only.
